title: Concept: Predictable randomness via rand.Intn (go) — review required
description: In go, rand.Intn is a statistical generator, not a cryptographic one: observing outputs reveals the state, and default seeds repeat across runs. Security values need unpredictability, which only crypto/rand provides in go.
applicability: go codebases drawing random values through rand.Intn; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Guessed session tokens, reset links, and nonces when predictable output guards access; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when the value directly authenticates.
